about.title: About
paragraphs: I build digital products end to end: from the business idea to architecture, backend and APIs, mobile and web apps, admin panels, and deployment. In 7+ years I've worked on 12 production apps across e-commerce, travel, fintech, and government — building some from scratch, and taking over, extending and releasing others. They include a weather forecasting platform for Iraq's national meteorological authority.

My core stack is Flutter for cross-platform mobile, and Laravel/PHP with MySQL for backends, with React on the web and C#/.NET for business systems. I work directly with clients from requirements to store release, which means fewer handoffs and faster delivery.

I'm currently open to senior engineering and technical leadership opportunities in Saudi Arabia and the GCC, as well as product development partnerships and long-term contracts — contributing to the digital transformation driving Vision 2030. Fluent in Arabic and English.

points: Leading development of the customer, store and courier Flutter apps
Building the web admin and vendor panels on a Laravel/PHP and MySQL backend
Integrating payments (Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal) and Uber Direct delivery
Owning releases to Google Play and the App Store, and CI deployment
Took over a Flutter app and carried it to production on both stores
Integrated SAR payments through EdfaPay and Apple Pay, and fixed Google and phone sign-in
Added Arabic/English localisation, dark mode and push notifications
Built and shipped Flutter apps for clients in e-commerce, travel and data storage
Worked directly with clients from requirements to store release
Built Laravel/MySQL backends and Firebase integrations
Developed accounting and automation software for exchange agencies, gold workshops and shipping companies
Built mobile apps connected to the accounting systems with Xamarin
Wrote backend logic in C# and VB.NET on MSSQL databases handling financial data
